context: Tech founder and engineer discuss a new pet-robot product
purpose: Teach: 人工/地下/地上/耐え/苦笑/辞典/ペット/ヒト

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 見てくれ、新しいペットロボット「ヒト型ミニ」の試作機だ。人工知能で感情も学習する。
lines.en: Look, this is the prototype of our new pet robot 'Mini Human-form.' It learns emotions using AI.
lines.style: Excited founder showing off a prototype with proud confident tone

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うわ、まじでヒトみたいに動くじゃん。ペットって言うか、もう家族レベルっしょ。
lines.en: Whoa, it really moves like a person. Calling it a pet is an understatement, it's family-level.
lines.style: Casual teen reaction with slangy excited surprise and admiration

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 地下の研究室で半年こもって作った。地上に出るのも忘れて、ずっとコード書いてたよ。
lines.en: I holed up in the basement lab for half a year. Forgot to even come up to the surface, just coding nonstop.
lines.style: Reflective founder explaining the grind with weary but proud honesty

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: そのスケジュール、よく耐えられたな…俺なら一週間でギブアップだわ。
lines.en: I can't believe you endured that schedule. I'd give up within a week.
lines.style: Impressed but slightly horrified teen with sympathetic disbelief

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: ははっ、苦笑するしかないね。睡眠時間は辞典で「不足」を引いたら俺の写真が出るレベル。
lines.en: Haha, all I can do is laugh wryly. If you looked up 'sleep deprivation' in a dictionary, my photo would be there.
lines.style: Self-deprecating humor with tired chuckle and witty exaggeration

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 辞典に載るなよ(笑)。でもさ、こいつ充電以外で何時間くらい耐え抜けるの?
lines.en: Don't end up in the dictionary, lol. But seriously, how many hours can this thing last on a single charge?
lines.style: Joking teen pivoting smoothly into a practical engineering question

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 連続稼働で約十時間。バッテリーは地下鉄一往復分くらい持つイメージだ。
lines.en: About ten hours of continuous use. Think of it as roughly one round trip on the subway.
lines.style: Founder giving a clear technical answer with a relatable analogy

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: なるほどね。これ、絶対バズるって。次世代のペット、一種の革命じゃん。
lines.en: Got it. This is definitely going to blow up. A next-gen pet, basically a revolution.
lines.style: Confident hyped teen predicting market success with casual conviction
